app.title: Show HN: Engrim – A universal, local-first SQLite memory engine for AI CLIs
app.author: timgordontg
app.description: An in‑memory SQLite‑compatible engine designed for local‑first AI command‑line interfaces, providing fast, temporary storage with zero‑config persistence
proposed_tests: Clone repo and install dependencies via cargo or pip
Run the CLI to create a temporary database and perform basic CRUD operations
Execute a benchmark inserting 10,000 rows and measure write latency
Run a SELECT with WHERE clause and compare query latency to SQLite in‑process
Check persistence across restarts using the optional persistence flag
